items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: She had Big Sid Catlett; I got to know him when I was over there playing.

ctx.x: that he could get away with on it... And he used it on me, and I got mad. I didn't like it. And I didn't... I had gone on the wagon, because I wanted to play good for him. But I decided to go with the guys finally at intermission and started going across the street, and then I'd come back and then I'd put him on, play and all that... I almost had a fist-fight with him one night, begged him to fire me...

And then I finally got a chance to go with Woody Herman, so I quit. And it was just like goin'...jumpin' into Heaven to go with Woody Herman. That's why ....(?). ... became one of my best friends. And Hazel Scott was the final on the stage. She had Big Sid Catlett; I got to know him when I was over there playing.
And I stayed with Woody... That was a good band. He was changing the band, and buying the guys... It was a cooperative band, see, and he was buying the guys out one by one.
